t: Din im lo erebu hachatzerot yachad vegam lo nishtattepu bammaboy
s: Din im lo erebu hachatzerot yachad vegam lo nishtattepu bammaboy ubo seip echad: kol shittupe meboot enam ella lehattir lehotzi letoko kelim sheshshabetu babbattim. Abal kelim sheshshabetu betoko o bachatzerot — muttar letaltelam bo beyoter mid' ammot umimmennu lachatzerot, ubilbad shello yaknisem labbayit, apillu erebu habbattim shebbechatzer. Ubilbad sheyyehe hammaboy metuqqan belechi o qora kehilkato, sheaz eno karmelit ap al pi shello nishtattepu bo, ureshut achat hu im hachatzerot lekelim sheshshabetu betokan, ben sheerebu hachatzerot leatzman ben shello erebu. Vekelim sheshshabetu bebeto, vehotziam lemaboy sheeno meshuttap o lechatzer sheenah meorebet bederek malbush o beissur — muttar letaltelam sham beyoter mid' ammot, abal asur letaltelam mechatzer lemaboy o lehepek, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"b:
